content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a company for violating their rights. The Commissioner of a regional office receives reports on consumer rights violations and submits his report to the Central Authority or to the Commissioner of a regional office, as the case may be.
content.outcome: The Commissioner of a regional office receives reports on consumer rights violations and submits his report to the Central Authority or to the Commissioner of a regional office, as the case may be.
